artifacts.title: Latch critical alarms
artifacts.body: Context: a transient unsafe condition can disappear while an operator is attending to another task. Decision: critical alarms are stateful and remain latched until acknowledgement and safe sensor state are both present. Consequences: the control path owns the latch, the UI cannot clear an active fault, and tests must cover acknowledge-while-unsafe and recovery.

artifacts.title: Use explicit validated configuration
artifacts.body: Context: operator edits and recovered storage may contain partially validated settings. Decision: apply an immutable validated configuration only after all bounds and checksum checks pass. Consequences: invalid edits preserve the current configuration; restart begins inhibited and requires explicit confirmation; configuration and validation evidence are logged.

artifacts.title: Air sensor transient not latched
artifacts.body: A transient high air reading is detected but the critical alarm clears without acknowledgement. Unsafe-condition indication can disappear before review. Impact assessment: Operator may miss an air condition; keep synthetic bench delivery inhibited until latch verification passes. Status rationale: Follow-up review required.

artifacts.title: Occlusion retest latency
artifacts.body: A release 1.0 sustained-pressure trial exceeded the configured dwell at a polling boundary. Impact assessment: Possible delayed occlusion warning; release 1.1 retest passes and closes this trial-specific issue. Status rationale: Follow-up review required.

artifacts.title: Audit export ordering
artifacts.body: Exporting a log with equal timestamps returns records in non-stable order. Impact assessment: Audit reconstruction may be ambiguous; the export ordering issue remains under investigation. Status rationale: Follow-up review required.

artifacts.title: Dose boundary message
artifacts.body: The dose validator rejects an invalid setting but presents an unclear field name. Impact assessment: Usability issue only in this fixture; corrected message has been verified. Status rationale: Fix and retest evidence closed the issue.

artifacts.title: Configuration restore checksum
artifacts.body: A corrupted saved configuration was read before checksum validation. Impact assessment: Unintended restart could use invalid limits; fixed by validation-before-restore. Status rationale: Fix and retest evidence closed the issue.

artifacts.title: UI
artifacts.body: Accept proposed rate/volume settings through ui_input; ui_confirm retains the previous configuration when the operator cancels. ui_status displays mode and delivered volume. Collaborates with Infusion Control for configuration acceptance; it cannot clear active unsafe alarms.

artifacts.title: Infusion Control
artifacts.body: Infusion Control validates DeliveryConfiguration atomically before start, rejects configuration edits while running, and clamps each delivered increment to remaining target volume. Sensor Monitoring supplies safe/fault decisions; Alarm Manager supplies active critical latches. Faults inhibit delivery and restart requires a valid configuration.

attributes.responsibility: Validated delivery state and volume bounds

artifacts.title: Sensor Monitoring
artifacts.body: Sensor Monitoring validates finite ordered pressure samples, applies the configured threshold and dwell interval, and retains an occlusion latch until safe acknowledgement. Air monitoring treats invalid or missing samples as faults. Calibration rejects invalid gain before activation. Pressure decisions request a critical alarm through Alarm Manager.

artifacts.title: Alarm Manager
artifacts.body: Alarm Manager records events independently of display refresh, orders visible alarms by priority, and keeps an unsafe condition active after acknowledgement. Critical active alarms request inhibited delivery; audio and display present that latch without owning its recovery state.

artifacts.title: Drug Library
artifacts.body: Drug Library resolves stable record keys and validates dose/rate against configured bounds before activation. Invalid values and missing records prevent configuration acceptance. Its validated limits support Infusion Control and are presented through operator configuration.

artifacts.title: Logging & Comms
artifacts.body: Comms & Logging retains ordered timestamped events, hashes records for integrity checks, validates framed messages and detects communication timeout. Diagnostics captures trace summaries. These services report faults; they do not own the delivery stop path.

attributes.responsibility: Ordered audit records and bounded communication

artifacts.title: Over infusion
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: over infusion during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Rate or accumulated-volume limits bypassed. Foreseeable harm: Life-threatening fluid overdose. Severity 5 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is life-threatening fluid overdose. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Under infusion
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: under infusion during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Motor stops without a sustained operator alert. Foreseeable harm: Interrupted therapy requiring intervention. Severity 4 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is interrupted therapy requiring intervention. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Air delivery
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: air delivery during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Air sensor fault or threshold not enforced. Foreseeable harm: Air embolism with serious injury. Severity 5 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is air embolism with serious injury. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Undetected occlusion
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: undetected occlusion during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Pressure sampling or alarm latency exceeds control limits. Foreseeable harm: Delayed therapy and potential serious deterioration. Severity 4 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is delayed therapy and potential serious deterioration. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Alarm unavailable
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: alarm unavailable during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Alarm output unavailable during a critical fault. Foreseeable harm: Unsafe delivery continuing without operator warning. Severity 5 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is unsafe delivery continuing without operator warning. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Incorrect drug limit
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: incorrect drug limit during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Library corruption or invalid dose limits accepted. Foreseeable harm: Incorrect medication delivery causing serious injury. Severity 4 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is incorrect medication delivery causing serious injury. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Lost audit evidence
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: lost audit evidence during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Event storage is lost or its ordering is corrupted. Foreseeable harm: Unavailable event evidence delays corrective action. Severity 3 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is unavailable event evidence delays corrective action. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Unintended restart
artifacts.body: Hazardous situation: unintended restart during commanded delivery. Cause sequence: Unvalidated stored configuration is resumed automatically. Foreseeable harm: Unexpected delivery after restart causes overdose. Severity 5 is assigned in the synthetic risk file because the consequence is unexpected delivery after restart causes overdose. Existing controls require explicit trace and verification; no residual-risk acceptance is asserted.

artifacts.title: Flow bounds
artifacts.body: Reject flow outside configured bounds. This behavior belongs to COMP-01 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Rates 0.01 and 120 mL/h are accepted under a 120 mL/h maximum; zero, negative, non-finite and 120.01 mL/h are rejected without configuration change.

artifacts.title: Volume limit
artifacts.body: Stop when delivered volume reaches configured target. This behavior belongs to COMP-02 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A target of 1 mL stops delivery at exactly 1 mL; a time step requesting more than the remaining volume is clamped to that remaining volume.

artifacts.title: Start interlock
artifacts.body: Reject start when configuration is invalid. This behavior belongs to COMP-03 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Start with missing configuration or an active sensor fault returns inhibited output and records a fault; start with valid settings enters RUNNING.

artifacts.title: Pause control
artifacts.body: Pause motor output on operator request. This behavior belongs to COMP-04 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Pausing a running session returns zero commanded output on the next tick and preserves accumulated delivered volume.

artifacts.title: Stop control
artifacts.body: Stop output and preserve delivered volume. This behavior belongs to COMP-05 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Stopping a session returns zero output on every subsequent tick; delivered volume and the stop event remain available.

artifacts.title: Rate conversion
artifacts.body: Convert flow into motor pulse intervals. This behavior belongs to COMP-06 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: At 60 mL/h and 60 pulses/mL the pulse interval is 1 s; nonpositive rate or calibration raises ValueError.

artifacts.title: Dose calculation
artifacts.body: Calculate dose from concentration and volume. This behavior belongs to COMP-01 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: For a dose of 2 units and concentration of 4 units/mL, the calculated volume is 0.5 mL; zero concentration is rejected.

artifacts.title: Air detection
artifacts.body: Stop infusion when air sensor exceeds the configured limit. This behavior belongs to COMP-02 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: An air reading above the configured limit stops output and latches an alarm; a missing or disconnected sample has the same inhibited outcome.

artifacts.title: Pressure sampling
artifacts.body: Validate pressure readings before use. This behavior belongs to COMP-03 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Negative, missing, non-finite and decreasing-timestamp pressure samples inhibit output; valid ordered samples preserve their measured value.

artifacts.title: Sensor diagnostics
artifacts.body: Latch a fault when the sensor disconnects. This behavior belongs to COMP-04 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Disconnecting a sensor produces a retained fault; reconnecting alone cannot clear it without an explicit safe acknowledgement.

artifacts.title: Alarm priority
artifacts.body: Prioritize critical faults over advisories. This behavior belongs to COMP-05 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Given advisory, warning and critical events, the selected visible event has critical priority; ties use stable code order.

artifacts.title: Alarm latch
artifacts.body: Keep critical alarms active until acknowledged safely. This behavior belongs to COMP-06 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A critical alarm remains active after acknowledgement while unsafe is true; it clears only after safe state and acknowledgement.

artifacts.title: Alarm acknowledgement
artifacts.body: Record acknowledgement without clearing an active unsafe condition. This behavior belongs to COMP-01 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Every acknowledgement appends an event containing the code and active state; acknowledging an unknown code raises KeyError.

artifacts.title: Audible alarm
artifacts.body: Schedule audible alerts while critical alarms remain active. This behavior belongs to COMP-02 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A critical active latch schedules an audible pulse at the configured interval; expired mute requests resume the scheduled pulse.

artifacts.title: Display status
artifacts.body: Show operating mode and delivered volume. This behavior belongs to COMP-03 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Status returns the current mode and delivered volume; a negative displayed volume is clamped to zero and never changes control state.

artifacts.title: Input validation
artifacts.body: Reject malformed operator entries. This behavior belongs to COMP-04 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Input text for a finite rate inside configured bounds is accepted; empty, malformed, negative and out-of-bounds text is rejected.

artifacts.title: Configuration confirmation
artifacts.body: Require confirmation before applying a new configuration. This behavior belongs to COMP-05 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Rejecting a configuration confirmation preserves the previous settings byte-for-byte; accepting returns a copy of the proposed validated settings.

artifacts.title: Drug limit validation
artifacts.body: Reject doses outside library limits. This behavior belongs to COMP-06 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Doses exactly at configured minimum and maximum are accepted; values below minimum or above maximum are rejected before volume calculation.

artifacts.title: Drug lookup
artifacts.body: Find configured drug records by stable key. This behavior belongs to COMP-01 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Lookup of a known drug key returns an independent record copy; missing keys raise KeyError and never return a default drug.

artifacts.title: Library checksum
artifacts.body: Reject a library with invalid checksum. This behavior belongs to COMP-02 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Modifying any serialized library entry changes the expected checksum; a mismatched checksum prevents library activation.

artifacts.title: Occlusion threshold
artifacts.body: The Sensor Monitoring component shall detect downstream occlusion when pressure remains above 80 kPa, stop output and request a latched critical alarm. A bounded dwell filters transient spikes without hiding sustained occlusion.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: With downstream pressure held above 80 kPa for 3 s, output is stopped and a critical alarm is latched at the 3 s boundary. Exactly 80 kPa does not trigger; invalid samples inhibit output.

artifacts.title: Pressure filtering
artifacts.body: Filter pressure samples over the configured window. This behavior belongs to COMP-03 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A filter window of 3 retains at most 3 valid values; input [10, 20, 30] yields 20, and an invalid sample leaves the window unchanged.

artifacts.title: Sensor calibration
artifacts.body: Apply calibration offset to valid readings. This behavior belongs to COMP-03 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A reading of 10 with offset 2 yields 12 under unit gain; a non-finite calibration or nonpositive gain is rejected before activation.

artifacts.title: Event persistence
artifacts.body: Append ordered events to the audit log. This behavior belongs to COMP-06 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Appending ordered events preserves insertion order and event content; a decreasing timestamp is rejected without altering existing records.

artifacts.title: Log integrity
artifacts.body: Detect modified log records using content digests. This behavior belongs to COMP-01 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Changing one byte in a recorded payload changes its SHA256 digest; verification against the original digest returns false.

artifacts.title: Communication framing
artifacts.body: Validate incoming message framing. This behavior belongs to COMP-02 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A frame begins with KIC: and ends with a newline; missing header, terminator, oversized or empty payload is rejected.

artifacts.title: Communication timeout
artifacts.body: Signal a timeout when a response is overdue. This behavior belongs to COMP-03 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A response age equal to the configured timeout is not overdue; an age greater than the timeout signals a retained communication fault.

artifacts.title: Delivery estimation
artifacts.body: Integrate commanded flow over elapsed time. This behavior belongs to COMP-04 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: At 60 mL/h over 60 s, commanded delivered volume increases by 1 mL while running; paused or inhibited sessions deliver zero.

artifacts.title: Watchdog
artifacts.body: Stop output when watchdog heartbeat expires. This behavior belongs to COMP-05 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: A heartbeat older than the configured expiry inhibits output; backwards or non-finite clock input raises a fault.

artifacts.title: Power loss recovery
artifacts.body: Restore only the last validated configuration. This behavior belongs to COMP-06 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Restart begins STOPPED with output inhibited; a stored configuration is applied only after complete bounds and checksum validation.

artifacts.title: Time validation
artifacts.body: Reject decreasing event timestamps. This behavior belongs to COMP-01 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Appending timestamp 9 after timestamp 10 raises ValueError and preserves the prior event sequence.

artifacts.title: Residual anomaly display
artifacts.body: Expose known residual anomalies to the operator. This behavior belongs to COMP-02 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Every known residual anomaly has its ID, state and impact visible in the review input; an unlisted open defect is reported as a gap.

artifacts.title: Export audit records
artifacts.body: Export selected audit records on request. This behavior belongs to COMP-03 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Exporting selected audit records preserves source order and content hashes; records outside the selected interval are excluded.

artifacts.title: Service access policy
artifacts.body: Require authorized service mode for calibration. This behavior belongs to COMP-04 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Calibration updates without service authorization are rejected; authorized updates still require valid finite calibration values.

artifacts.title: Localization selection
artifacts.body: Select the configured display language. This behavior belongs to COMP-05 and prevents silent divergence between operator intent and delivered therapy. Reject invalid input explicitly and retain the prior validated state on failure.

attributes.acceptance_criteria: Selecting a configured language returns its label set; an unavailable language returns an explicit validation error rather than mixed labels.

artifacts.title: Verify flow bounds
artifacts.body: Preconditions: Reset synthetic bench; valid configuration; event recorder enabled. Steps: 1. Configure maximum 120 mL/h and target 1 mL while STOPPED.; 2. Apply 0.01 and 120 mL/h; verify acceptance at both boundaries.; 3. Propose 0, -1, 120.01 and NaN rates.; 4. Verify each rejected proposal retains the last valid configuration and output remains inhibited. Expected result: Rates 0.01 and 120 mL/h are accepted under a 120 mL/h maximum; zero, negative, non-finite and 120.01 mL/h are rejected without configuration change.

steps.action: 1. Configure maximum 120 mL/h and target 1 mL while STOPPED.; 2. Apply 0.01 and 120 mL/h; verify acceptance at both boundaries.; 3. Propose 0, -1, 120.01 and NaN rates.; 4. Verify each rejected proposal retains the last valid configuration and output remains inhibited.
steps.expected: Rates 0.01 and 120 mL/h are accepted under a 120 mL/h maximum; zero, negative, non-finite and 120.01 mL/h are rejected without configuration change.

artifacts.title: Verify volume limit
artifacts.body: Preconditions: Reset synthetic bench; valid configuration; event recorder enabled. Steps: 1. Configure rate 120 mL/h, target 1 mL and valid safe inputs.; 2. Start delivery and request a 60 s time step, exceeding remaining target volume.; 3. Verify only 1 mL is delivered and mode becomes STOPPED.; 4. Apply another 60 s tick and verify zero further delivery. Expected result: A target of 1 mL stops delivery at exactly 1 mL; a time step requesting more than the remaining volume is clamped to that remaining volume.

steps.action: 1. Configure rate 120 mL/h, target 1 mL and valid safe inputs.; 2. Start delivery and request a 60 s time step, exceeding remaining target volume.; 3. Verify only 1 mL is delivered and mode becomes STOPPED.; 4. Apply another 60 s tick and verify zero further delivery.
steps.expected: A target of 1 mL stops delivery at exactly 1 mL; a time step requesting more than the remaining volume is clamped to that remaining volume.

artifacts.title: Verify occlusion threshold
artifacts.body: Preconditions: Reset synthetic bench; valid configuration; event recorder enabled. Steps: 1. Configure pressure threshold 80 kPa and dwell 3 s; start from an unlatched monitor.; 2. Apply 80 kPa; verify no occlusion.; 3. Apply 80.1 kPa at t=0 and t=2.99 s; verify dwell has not latched.; 4. Apply 80.1 kPa at t=3 s; verify stop request and critical alarm latch.; 5. Acknowledge at 80.1 kPa; verify latch remains active.; 6. Supply a missing or decreasing-time sample; verify fault and inhibited output. Expected result: With downstream pressure held above 80 kPa for 3 s, output is stopped and a critical alarm is latched at the 3 s boundary. Exactly 80 kPa does not trigger; invalid samples inhibit output.

steps.action: 1. Configure pressure threshold 80 kPa and dwell 3 s; start from an unlatched monitor.; 2. Apply 80 kPa; verify no occlusion.; 3. Apply 80.1 kPa at t=0 and t=2.99 s; verify dwell has not latched.; 4. Apply 80.1 kPa at t=3 s; verify stop request and critical alarm latch.; 5. Acknowledge at 80.1 kPa; verify latch remains active.; 6. Supply a missing or decreasing-time sample; verify fault and inhibited output.
steps.expected: With downstream pressure held above 80 kPa for 3 s, output is stopped and a critical alarm is latched at the 3 s boundary. Exactly 80 kPa does not trigger; invalid samples inhibit output.
